results.title: Full-irrep heralded LER — Square and Honeycomb
results.summary: Six panels: Square left, Honeycomb right; U(1), SU(2), SU(3) top to bottom. Red darkens from L=5 to L=11. Shared p axis, independent LER scales, common legend below. Wilson 95% intervals; 20,000 shots per sampled cell. Rough-boundary m,R unmeasured.
